title: Prospective study on adaptive as well as the stereotactic high precision radiotherapy in patients in palliative care
summary: Here, the modern technical standards are to be evaluated prospectively. This study aims to assess the influence of the new technical therapy standards (adaptive radiotherapy, adaptive re-planning, radiosurgery, stereotactic radiotherapy) using the newly established and installed linear accelerators ETHOS or / and the Truebeams in the Clinic for Radiation Therapy, with regard to dose parameters for quality assurance of feasibility. Therapy with ETHOS represents a comprehensive new treatment option that is tailored and individualized from the initial planning, through adaptation on the treatment table, to radiation monitoring on the patient. This lays the foundation, on the one hand, for standardizing treatment parameters as much as possible and, on the other hand, for introducing improvements in the therapy of future patients.
conditions: Palliative care and radiotherapy, symptom relief, local therapy, high-precision therapy, efficiency, safety
